title: Neighbourhood Coffee Subscription
scope: Fictional example - monthly subscription at a community shop
summary: Local residents subscribe monthly for their everyday coffee, collected in store, giving the shop recurring subscription revenue.

sources.label: Fictional project description, for demonstration only
sources.detail: Fictional case: a community coffee shop offers a prepaid subscription of 20 cups a month for a flat monthly fee. It targets residents within a ten-minute walk who drink coffee at least three times a week. A small app handles subscribing, reserving a cup and checking the remaining balance; collection is in store, and the rule for unused cups is undecided. Customers come from in-store tastings and resident referrals, a community group collects feedback, and staff handle after-sales. A roaster supplies the beans and a payment provider settles the money. The shop has a street-front unit, an espresso machine, baristas and the app. Daily work is preparing and making the coffee, maintaining the reservation system and following up on member feedback. Costs include rent and wages, beans, milk and packaging, and payment fees. No renewal or margin data was provided.
